subject.title: fix: silent credential-save failures and session/tool hygiene gaps

question: Should temporary executable resources remain ephemeral, or become a persistent per-agent cache with an explicit freshness and cleanup contract?
rationale: The branch improves cross-user permissions but also changes executable-resource lifetime and trust from OS-temporary to persistent agent state; repository policy and the security tradeoff require an intentional owner decision.

options.title: Use private ephemeral installs
options.body: Create an unpredictable mode-0700 temporary root with lifecycle cleanup so executable resources do not persist or become stale.

options.title: Define a managed persistent cache
options.body: Keep the agent-local location only with explicit version/freshness validation, bounded cleanup, symlink defenses, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Defer the resource relocation
options.body: Land the unrelated fixes while leaving the temporary-path security change for a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Use private ephemeral installs
recommendation.body: Create an unpredictable mode-0700 temporary root with lifecycle cleanup so executable resources do not persist or become stale.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent package-runtime and filesystem-hardening work is the closest available ownership signal for this boundary.
